ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The circuit ports are node 1 and node 2; there is a 100 Ω resistor between node 1 and node 2. On the left there is also a branch from node 1 through a 1 kΩ resistor to an upper node, and then through a 9 kΩ resistor to node 2. On the right is a controlled current source, labeled 99i_b, with the arrow downward; its upper terminal is connected to node 2 through an outer wire, and its lower terminal is connected to node 1. In the figure, i_b is marked on the top wire, with the arrow to the right. Reasoning: Let node 2 be the reference ground, and apply a test voltage V at node 1. Let the voltage of the upper node between 1 kΩ and 9 kΩ be v_x; then this node is obtained by voltage division of 1 kΩ and 9 kΩ, giving v_x = 9 kΩ/(1 kΩ + 9 kΩ) · V = 0.9V. Therefore the current flowing out from node 1 through the 1 kΩ branch is (V - 0.9V)/1 kΩ = V/10 kΩ. Since the direction of the i_b arrow in the figure is opposite to the direction of this actual branch current, i_b = -V/10 kΩ. The controlled source arrow is downward, indicating that the current from node 2 to node 1 is 99i_b; converted into the current contribution from node 1 to node 2, it is -99i_b = 99V/10 kΩ. The port input current is the sum of three parts: the 100 Ω branch V/100, the 1 kΩ–9 kΩ branch V/10000, and the controlled-source contribution 99V/10000, so I_in = V/100 + V/10000 + 99V/10000 = V/100 + 100V/10000 = V/50. Therefore the input impedance Z_in = V/I_in = 50 Ω.

raw_record.question_text: The impedance looking into nodes 1 and 2 in the given circuit is _____ (Ω).

method.method_draft: Set node 2 as reference and apply a test voltage V at node 1. For the upper-left node between the 1 kΩ and 9 kΩ resistors, solve the divider/KCL: its voltage is 0.9V, so the current from node 1 through the 1 kΩ branch is V/10 kΩ. Because the defined i_b arrow on the top wire is opposite to the actual branch current direction, i_b = -V/10 kΩ. The dependent source current is 99i_b downward from node 2 to node 1, so as a current from node 1 to node 2 it contributes -99i_b = 99V/10 kΩ. Add currents from node 1 to node 2: through 100 Ω is V/100, through the 1 kΩ–9 kΩ branch is V/10000, and through the dependent source contribution is 99V/10000. Thus I_in = V/100 + 100V/10000 = V/50, giving Z_in = 50 Ω.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路端口为节点 1 和节点 2；节点 1 与节点 2 之间有一个 100 Ω 电阻。左侧还有一条从节点 1 经 1 kΩ 电阻到上方节点、再经 9 kΩ 电阻到节点 2 的支路。右侧是受控电流源，标注为 99i_b，箭头向下；其上端通过外侧导线接到节点 2，下端接到节点 1。图中 i_b 标在顶部导线上，箭头向右。

推理：令节点 2 为参考地，在节点 1 加测试电压 V。设 1 kΩ 与 9 kΩ 之间的上方节点电压为 v_x，则该节点由 1 kΩ 与 9 kΩ 分压得到 v_x = 9 kΩ/(1 kΩ + 9 kΩ) · V = 0.9V。因此从节点 1 经 1 kΩ 支路流出的电流为 (V - 0.9V)/1 kΩ = V/10 kΩ。由于图中 i_b 箭头方向与该实际支路电流方向相反，所以 i_b = -V/10 kΩ。受控源箭头向下，表示从节点 2 到节点 1 的电流为 99i_b；换算成从节点 1 到节点 2 的电流贡献为 -99i_b = 99V/10 kΩ。端口输入电流为三部分相加：100 Ω 支路 V/100，1 kΩ–9 kΩ 支路 V/10000，受控源贡献 99V/10000，所以 I_in = V/100 + V/10000 + 99V/10000 = V/100 + 100V/10000 = V/50。故输入阻抗 Z_in = V/I_in = 50 Ω。
